dst.text: Malil, Memnarch's golem servant, helps rebuild the Panopticon after the green lacuna blasts through it and topples it.

When Memnarch learns the vedalken are chasing the elf Glissa, he sends Malil to retrieve her, but cornered by Malil's threshers and levelers, Glissa channels green fire in an explosive burst that disables all pursuers.
The nim attack the levelers, letting Glissa's group slip away from Malil, and a standoff between Pontifex and Malil later lets her escape and find the Kaldra shield.
Glissa and Slobad survive the final blast, as do Memnarch and Malil.
